title: Google Ads and Paid Media in Ireland: The Complete Guide

facts.fact: The page states that Target CPA and Target ROAS smart bidding work well in Ireland once an account has enough conversion volume, which typically takes a few weeks of consistent data.
facts.quote: Target CPA and Target ROAS strategies work well in Ireland once you have enough conversion volume to learn from, typically a few weeks of consistent data.

facts.fact: The Orbis guide claims that a euro spent well in paid media returns three or four euros, a vendor claim rather than a third-party measured figure.
facts.quote: a euro spent badly disappears just as quickly as a euro spent well returns three or four.

facts.fact: The page states that a skippable in-stream YouTube ad has roughly five seconds to earn viewer attention before the viewer can skip it.
facts.quote: A skippable in-stream ad has roughly five seconds to earn attention before the viewer hits skip

facts.fact: In the page's starting-out budget framework for Irish paid media, 80% of the monthly budget goes to Search and Shopping, 20% to remarketing, and 0% to prospecting and video.
facts.unit: % of monthly budget (Search and Shopping / Remarketing / Prospecting and video)

facts.fact: In the page's scaling-stage budget framework, 60% of the monthly budget goes to Search and Shopping, 20% to remarketing, and 20% to prospecting and video.
facts.unit: % of monthly budget (Search and Shopping / Remarketing / Prospecting and video)

facts.fact: In the page's mature-stage budget framework, 50% of the monthly budget goes to Search and Shopping, 15% to remarketing, and 35% to prospecting and video.
facts.unit: % of monthly budget (Search and Shopping / Remarketing / Prospecting and video)

facts.fact: The page recommends holding a seasonal reserve of often 20 to 30 percent of annual paid media budget for peak weeks when competition and returns spike.
facts.quote: hold a seasonal reserve, often 20 to 30 percent of annual budget, for the peak weeks

facts.fact: The page says Christmas is a long peak that rewards advertisers who start in November and sustain through to last-order dates and the post-Christmas sales.
facts.quote: A long peak that rewards advertisers who start in November and sustain through to last-order dates

facts.fact: The page advises that an Irish advertiser's Google Ads budget should usually be at least a few hundred euro a month per active campaign so the campaign can exit the learning phase.
facts.unit: euro per month per active campaign
facts.quote: usually at least a few hundred euro a month per active campaign so it can exit the learning phase

facts.fact: Orbis, the vendor publishing the page, states it has more than fifteen years of experience.
facts.quote: Orbis brings fifteen years of experience, a Google Partner badge, a 4.9-star rating across 58 reviews

facts.fact: Orbis states it has completed paid media programmes more than five hundred times, per its own claim.
facts.quote: a partner that has done it more than five hundred times

facts.fact: Orbis reports a 4.9-star rating across 58 reviews on its own page.
The page names five Irish cities (Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick and Waterford) as markets that reward location bid adjustments and local copy.
facts.quote: Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick and Waterford reward location bid adjustments and local copy.
